checks.detail: Without arguments the launcher verifies the package, supplies source and manifest environment, performs editor import, then starts GUI Godot directly on the playable scene. The --self-test branch is separate.
Normal launch supplies the same source and manifest binding as the qualified probe.
The original synchronous Lab shortcut remains a normal direct scene launch.
Top-level guide is byte-identical to bundled canonical playtest instructions.
Guide control labels match delivered UI; seed applies on reset, pump defaults4000us with0us control, hold is diagnostic.
Export captures host/session/preset/config/UI timing, flushes JSONL checkpoint, writes incident JSON, prints exact paths and opens their directory without toggling running.
Incident and trace retain actual manifest byte digest plus observed source identity; unchanged manifest carries tree/runtime/input hashes.
Prospective JSONL bounds32MiB/100000records; saturation is explicit and does not pause play.

reports.path_instructions: Use Export bug report: it opens the actual OS directory; the footer shows full incident and trace paths. No guessed fixed drive/path is required.

reports.completed_replay: Pause, wait until pending input and the admitted interval drain, then Export. An active unresolved export remains incident evidence and may explicitly refuse standalone replay.

five_minute_playtest.precondition: Extract whole ZIP into a new writable directory; allow first import before the five-minute play period. Keep hold receipts unchecked and receipt work at default. Do not use global F2 until OPERATOR-01 is resolved.

steps.action: Run Verify ObjectShard Lab.cmd, then Open ObjectShard M3 Preflight.cmd without arguments. Wait for Native material ready. Open Configuration briefly; confirm seed12 and4ms soft budget, then collapse it.
steps.pass: Verifier succeeds and the ordinary playable A scene appears paused, with material and controls.
steps.fail: Hash mismatch, native/import error, blank scene, auto-exit into probe receipt, or wrong source.

steps.action: Click Resume. Left-drag Erase through the lower Wood support, or use Cut lower support. While the crown falls, paint a short Sand or Water stroke in empty World space; right-click a moving cell to inspect.
steps.pass: World clock advances; structure transfers once, falls and collides; edits enter the retained queue and apply or show explicit refusal; moving inspection identifies ObjectShard.
steps.fail: Floating main structure despite a complete accepted cut and free capacity, duplicate image/owner, invisible collision, silent edit loss, unexplained Held/fault, or stopped advertised progression.

steps.action: Try a fresh one-cell Erase on moving Wood; retry a TargetChanged refusal with a fresh stroke. Wait for the body to sleep naturally, then click Erode resting cell and continue observing.
steps.pass: Accepted cut removes real owned material; geometry stays associated with the body. After natural sleep and erosion there is no violent late rotation.
steps.fail: Fresh accepted cut damages a different owner/cell, ghost geometry, unexplained inventory loss, violent late twitch or inconsistent hold.
steps.qualification: A TargetChanged refusal is a safe stale witness result. If natural sleep has not occurred within this time allocation, extend observation and mark settling not yet established; do not force sleep.

steps.action: Pause and let pending operations drain; Single step, then Resume. Export once while running. Reset, wait for the fresh paused scene, then select J · Sustained external flame and Resume for visible Fire/Smoke; return to A if desired.
steps.pass: Single step advances one requested interval after pending completion; export opens files without pausing; reset/scenario change cleanly replaces the session; J creates genuine visible external Fire.
steps.fail: Old moving bodies survive reset, controls stop responding, export claims success without files, or changed scenario retains stale owners.

steps.action: Pause and let queues drain, then Export bug report for a completed-input reproduction. Close the window normally, relaunch M3, and confirm a fresh A scene. Close it and open Open ObjectShard Lab.cmd to confirm the preserved control remains accessible.
steps.pass: Incident+JSONL exist, report source matches manifest, normal window close exits, relaunch is clean, and old Lab opens independently.
steps.fail: Missing/incomplete files without explicit reason, stale previous session on relaunch, shutdown hang or unavailable Lab shortcut.

renderer_scope.normal_route: Project gl_compatibility with ordinary driver selection; no launcher --rendering-driver override.
renderer_scope.qualified_gui_probe: --self-test uses explicit opengl3_angle. The actual owner hardware/default-driver path remains owner evaluation, not claimed as hosted NVIDIA acceptance.

findings.status: source-confirmed route; runtime consequence pending targeted review
findings.detail: Global F2 navigation schedules direct scene replacement. Delivered rehearsal has only window-close and Reset shutdown paths, no navigation hook/_exit_tree; worker/host have no destructor stop/join. Thus F2 can remove the polling scene before exclusive native-owner and RID disposal. It also leaves SceneTree.auto_accept_quit=false set by the departed scene.
findings.disposition: Root notified before final readiness; no source/package mutation or execution in this review. Normal window-close and reset remain the intended reviewed routes; do not treat a workaround as resolution.
